BrochureContent.Content:
• Sought after rural location at Curraghtown, Culmullin located between Dunshaughlin and Kilcock
• Ideal for a residential site subject to the necessary planning permission
• Good road frontage onto the Kilcock Dunshaughlin road, R125
• Purchaser to satisfy Meath County Council`s Local Needs Criteria

Guide Price

Excess 165,000.

Type of Transaction

Private Treaty

Description 

An excellent opportunity to acquire an approx. 0.6 acre site, offered for sale subject to planning permission for a single residence, in a highly sought after rural location in Curraghtown, Culmullen.

The property enjoys a pleasant countryside setting while remaining within close proximity to Dunshaughlin, Kilcock & Maynooth which offer local schools, services, and amenities. The M3 & M4 motorways are nearby, providing excellent connectivity to Dublin and the wider region. 

This site represents an ideal opportunity for a qualifying purchaser seeking to construct a one-off family home in a desirable countryside location.

The site is being sold subject to the purchaser satisfying Meath County Council`s Local Needs Criteria, in accordance with the Meath County Development Plan.

Please note all maps are for identification purposes only.

Location

The subject property is located less than 8km from Dunshaughlin. Easy access is provided to the M3 & M4, Dublin city centre and Dublin airport. There is a wealth of recreational amenities in the area including golfing, horse-riding as well as excellent sporting activities.

The towns of Dunboyne, Maynooth and Kilcock are all within a short drive. The property is approx. 13km from the M3 and the train station at Pace Dunboyne. Dublin is approximately a 40-minute drive.

Planning

The lands will be sold subject to planning permission for a single private residence.

Zoning

The lands are unzoned in the Meath County Development Plan.

Services

Interested parties are required to satisfy themselves in relation to the availability and adequacy of services.

Title

Freehold.

Viewing

Viewings available by appointment only.

Directions:

From Culmullen, Co. Meath take the R125 towards Kilcock for approximately 2 kilometres and the property for sale is on your left hand side (see sign).
